svg.title: Private Liquidity and Rewards Router: detailed proposed architecture
svg.desc: Execution, liquidity, ZK eligibility, RPC privacy, 0G AI, funded rewards, and production boundaries. Public crypto settlement is not represented as confidential.
svg.text: Browser extension, selective disclosure, liquidity routing and funded incentives
Fast matching offchain • signed limits enforced onchain • fiat settlement remains asynchronous
Protection depends on what each participant can observe.
Matching operator sees order details in v1
Created → Quoted → Signed → Reserved → Executed → Confirmed → Complete
Chain preconfirmation, bank payout and reward release are separate events.
Keys, encrypted profile and credential witnesses stay local.
Anon-RPC + real anonymizing transport. The RPC endpoint still sees the query.
Provider retains KYC. ZK reveals the accepted predicate and public inputs.
Minimize input data. Verify TeeML / TeeTLS mode; external APIs may see prompts.
Operator sees orders in v1. Public swaps expose token amounts and addresses.
Stronger privacy needs a confidential matcher and shielded settlement. Timing,
public deposits and withdrawals can still leak relationships.
Idempotent events; reconcile to external truth
Principal and reward funding stay separate
Each party receives its own benefit
Reward states: Estimated → Pending → Earned → Claimable → Paid | Cancel or reverse when required
Assumptions only. No live rate or guaranteed reward. A single benefit cannot be duplicated.
Uniswap testnet swaps · local demo-credential proof
Actual 0G calls · Anon-RPC · prefunded test rewards
Sandbox fiat events · explicit failures · measured latency
Approved ramp corridors · real credential issuer
Audited adapters · capital controls · reconciliation & recovery
Confidential matcher + shielded notes for stronger privacy
External review + load testing before production funds
Merchant checkout → funded user cashback + agreed platform commission
BROWSER EXTENSION · BEST CARD & BEST RATE
Shopping • travel / tickets • subscriptions • supported ramp and swap pages | Active tab or explicitly approved sites
Merchant, cart amount and currency from approved page metadata.
Use active-tab / optional site permission; ignore payment fields.
Exact card variant, network and user-confirmed remaining caps.
Encrypted local profile; never collect PAN, CVV, PIN or OTP.
Official issuer circulars + merchant offer terms, version and source date.
Approved provider APIs supply total fees, net output and quote expiry.
Net value = eligible discount + estimated reward value − extra fees.
Check minimum spend, caps, stacking, redemption value and exclusions.
0G explains the validated choice with source links and uncertainty.
User chooses card or route; merchant / provider / wallet authorizes payment.
No bank-login cookies or hidden payment-field capture. Page content is untrusted input. Expired quotes need refresh; uncertain eligibility is labelled.
Sponsorship or commission must not silently alter ranking.
INR 500 instant discount + INR 100 estimated reward
Cash due INR 9,500 · effective cost INR 9,400
INR 300 discount + INR 200 point value − INR 49 fee
Live view: remaining cap, eligibility confidence, source links and checked-at time.
You authorize payment with the merchant.
Fees included · quote expiry shown in live view
Compare like-for-like network and payment rail
Rank by net fiat received and payout conditions
Live view: fee breakdown, payout timing, price impact and provider availability.
Provider or wallet authorization is required.
PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE • A = buyer; B = seller • No deployment or throughput claim
Demo chain: Unichain Sepolia | Public swaps remain observable | Preconfirmation ≠ finality
